Most investors think diversification means owning 40–50 stocks. But is that really necessary? In this video, Aastha Khurana breaks down how diversification actually works — and the number of stocks you really need in a portfolio. We also explore the difference between risks you can control and the ones you can’t, and why adding more stocks isn’t always the answer. If you’ve ever wondered whether your portfolio is truly diversified, this will change how you think about it. Because in investing, it’s not about owning more — it’s about owning better.
